function.name: calculate_paint_mix

message.content:
**Pantone “Sky Blue”**

| System | Pantone Code | Hex | Approx. RGB |
|--------|--------------|-----|-------------|
| Pantone Fashion, Home & Interiors (TCX) | **14‑4318** | #87CEEB | R 135 G 206 B 235 |
| Pantone Color Bridge (Print) | **14‑4318** | #87CEEB | R 135 G 206 B 235 |
| Pantone 2020 Color of the Year (Sky Blue) | **14‑4318** | #87CEEB | R 135 G 206 B 235 |

> **Note:**  
> *Pantone 14‑4318* is the most widely referenced “Sky Blue” across Pantone’s major color systems (Fashion, Home & Interiors, and the Color Bridge).  
> If you’re working with a specific Pantone system (e.g., Pantone Textile, Pantone Digital), the exact code may differ slightly, but 14‑4318 remains the canonical “sky blue” reference.

If you need a mix of other Pantone shades to approximate a particular sky‑blue hue, let me know and I can help calculate a blend!
